name: Cupid
source:
A transfer student arrives at a Korean high school with five days left before everything settles. On the first day, three classmates pull him in different directions: Seoyeon, the composed student council president; Yuna, a quiet literature club member who would rather pass notes than talk; and Dain, a volleyball regular who treats him like an old friend.

Choices, after-school conversations, and an affinity gauge decide who he stays close to. Each day is split into morning, lunch, after school, and night, and the week ends in one of many routes.

[spoiler]Two additional routes can be unlocked with the homeroom teacher and the school nurse. Those paths stay within professional bounds during the school week; romance, if it happens, only begins years later as adults.[/spoiler]
